## Clinic Wait-Time Dashboard Overview

A clean operational dashboard should focus on **wait intensity, daily load, and time-of-day patterns**.
From the data, the **longest average wait** is **27 minutes** for **General on 2025-05-02 during 12:00–16:00**.

## Dashboard KPIs and Chart Layout

| KPI | Value | What it shows |
|---|---:|---|
| Total patients seen | 418 | Overall volume across all rows |
| Average wait time | 19.3 min | Overall clinic wait experience |
| Longest average wait | 27 min | Peak congestion point |
| Highest-volume block | 45 patients | Busiest single department/time block |

### Recommended 3-Charts Dashboard
- **Chart 1: Average Wait by Day and Department** — grouped bar chart showing each date split by General vs Pediatrics.
- **Chart 2: Average Wait by Time Block** — bar or line chart comparing 08:00–12:00 vs 12:00–16:00 across all days.
- **Chart 3: Patients Seen vs Average Wait** — scatter plot to show whether higher volume aligns with longer waits.

## Operational Findings by Day and Time

| Date | Department | Time Block | Patients Seen | Avg Wait (min) |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|
| 2025-05-01 | General | 08:00–12:00 | 42 | 18 |
| 2025-05-01 | General | 12:00–16:00 | 38 | 24 |
| 2025-05-01 | Pediatrics | 08:00–12:00 | 30 | 14 |
| 2025-05-01 | Pediatrics | 12:00–16:00 | 28 | 19 |
| 2025-05-02 | General | 08:00–12:00 | 40 | 21 |
| 2025-05-02 | General | 12:00–16:00 | 35 | 27 |
| 2025-05-02 | Pediatrics | 08:00–12:00 | 32 | 16 |
| 2025-05-02 | Pediatrics | 12:00–16:00 | 29 | 20 |
| 2025-05-03 | General | 08:00–12:00 | 45 | 17 |
| 2025-05-03 | General | 12:00–16:00 | 41 | 25 |
| 2025-05-03 | Pediatrics | 08:00–12:00 | 31 | 15 |
| 2025-05-03 | Pediatrics | 12:00–16:00 | 27 | 18 |

### Pattern by time of day
- **12:00–16:00 is consistently slower** than 08:00–12:00 for both departments on every day.
- **General** has longer waits than **Pediatrics** in every matching time block.
- The clearest congestion point is the **afternoon General clinic**, which drives the peak wait.
